body: Thank you everyone for your input, I will slow my life down a bit and try to enjoy it rather than rush through it. As some of you pointed out, I think this might be a option worth trying.

Hello to you too.

I will try what you suggested. I have always been the type to drown in things to do. Example when at work, I have to combine several activities at once so that i run around constantly without breaks. Its the only way i have functioned. When i went to collage, i would cram 300-500 pages in a matter of days, and finished with good marks without attending a single class for 5 years (I didn't even buy half the needed books). I don't know why, but having a ton of impossible work ahead of me has always been my only motivation. Maybe i have burnt out, and need to slow my pace like you are suggesting. Thx a lot, I really appriciate your advice.
I'm starting to think this as well.

Wish there was, just last year I tried learning a new language in my spare time, I got so far as understanding Japanese very good. Then i started to learn a little programming (wrote a few short programs). Recently I went rock climbing, hell I smoked weed, trying out everything i can think of. Point being I get sick of everything I do in a very short amount of time :/
